scenario: Integer overflow wraps silently per LEXP.12.10 — 64-bit signed; documented, no runtime guard. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `t.v + 9223372036854775000` near `INT64_MAX` compiles. The wrap happens at runtime, and `compile_ok` does not observe it. The wrap is pinned by runtime/LCON.2.6.twos_complement_wrap.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v + 9223372036854775000 > 0
->
    log info "x"
